content.text:
Here is the complete, in-order list of everything applied when creating an owner via **POST /api/owners**. The endpoint is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`).

## Phase 0 — Security (before anything else)
1. **`@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`** — caller must have `ROLE_OWNER_ADMIN`, else **403**. (Enforcement depends on `petclinic.security.enable` / method security being on.)

## Phase 1 — Bean Validation on the request body
Triggered by `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` (declared on the generated `OwnersApi` interface). Any failure throws `MethodArgumentNotValidException`, handled by `ExceptionControllerAdvice` → **400** with field error details. Constraints on `OwnerFieldsDto`:
2. **firstName** — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$")`
3. **lastName** — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..30)`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$")`
4. **address** — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..255)`, `@Pattern(".*\S.*")` (non-blank)
5. **city** — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..80)`, `@Pattern(".*\S.*")`
6. **telephone** — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`
7. **email** — `@Size(max 255)`, `@Email` (optional)
8. **postcode** — `@Pattern("^[0-9]{4}$")` (optional)
9. **registrationDate** — `@Valid` (optional)

## Phase 2 — Controller body logic (in this exact order)
10. **Map DTO → `Owner`** via `ownerMapper.toOwner`.
11. **Address normalization** — trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST→STREET / RD→ROAD / AVE→AVENUE. Empty result → **400**. *(mutates address)*
12. **Telephone → E.164** (`toE164`) — strip separators; `+`kept, leading `0`→`+61`, else `+1`; must be 8–15 digits and pass national-length check (`+61`=9, `+1`=10). Invalid → **400**. *(mutates telephone)*
13. **Email normalization** (only if present) — trim, regex `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`, lower-case. Invalid → **400**. *(mutates email)*
14. **Postcode validation** (only if present) — must be `[0-9]{4}` and fall within the region range for its city (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099). Invalid → **400**.
15. **Registration date defaulting** — if null, set to `LocalDate.now()`. *(mutates registrationDate)*
16. **Business-day adjustment** (`toBusinessDay`) — roll Sat/Sun forward to Monday. *(mutates registrationDate)*
17. **Per-city cap** — if `countOwnersInCity(city) >= 50` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY`) → **409 CONFLICT**.
18. **Per-day cap** — if `countOwnersRegisteredOn(date) >= 100` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY`) → **429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS**.
19. **Household assignment** — find existing owners sharing normalized lastName+address, compute a deterministic `householdId` (SHA-256, first 12 hex, upper-cased), and **⚠️ side-effect: persist every existing household member whose `householdId` changed** via `clinicService.saveOwner(member)` — writes to *other* rows, each in its own transaction.
20. **Duplicate/identity check** — build `identityKey = telephone|email|householdId`; if any existing owner matches → **409 CONFLICT**.
21. **Set derived fields on the new owner**: `customerCode` (`CITY3-LAST3-NNNN`), `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), `namesakeCount` (count of existing same first+last name).
22. **Persist the new owner** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` → `@Transactional`, `ownerRepository.save` (persist since id is null; `pets` cascade ALL).
23. **Audit log side-effect** — one line to the dedicated `AUDIT` logger (`owner created: id=…`).
24. **Build response** — map to `OwnerDto`, set `bulkSignupWarning` flag (true if >80 owners registered today), set `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header → **201 CREATED**.

## Notes
- The **service layer is a thin pass-through** — all business logic/validation lives in the controller; `saveOwner` just delegates to the repository inside a transaction.
- The **entity carries its own Bean Validation** (`Owner`/`Person`: `@NotEmpty` on firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone; telephone `@Pattern("^(\+[0-9]{8,15}|[0-9]{10})$")`), enforced by Hibernate on flush — a second validation layer behind the DTO.
- **No JPA lifecycle callbacks / auditing** (`@PrePersist`, `@EntityListeners`, `@CreatedDate` etc.) exist — `registrationDate` is set manually, not by auditing.
- **No email is sent and no Spring event is published** anywhere in this path; the only outbound "notification" is the AUDIT log line.
- The controller itself is **not `@Transactional`**, so the household-member writes (step 19) and the new-owner save (step 22) commit as separate transactions.

11. **Address normalization** — trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST→STREET / RD→ROAD / AVE→AVENUE. Empty result → **400**. *(mutates address)*
12. **Telephone → E.164** (`toE164`) — strip separators; `+`kept, leading `0`→`+61`, else `+1`; must be 8–15 digits and pass national-length check (`+61`=9, `+1`=10). Invalid → **400**. *(mutates telephone)*
13. **Email normalization** (only if present) — trim, regex `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`, lower-case. Invalid → **400**. *(mutates email)*
14. **Postcode validation** (only if present) — must be `[0-9]{4}` and fall within the region range for its city (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099). Invalid → **400**.
15. **Registration date defaulting** — if null, set to `LocalDate.now()`. *(mutates registrationDate)*
16. **Business-day adjustment** (`toBusinessDay`) — roll Sat/Sun forward to Monday. *(mutates registrationDate)*
17. **Per-city cap** — if `countOwnersInCity(city) >= 50` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY`) → **409 CONFLICT**.
18. **Per-day cap** — if `countOwnersRegisteredOn(date) >= 100` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY`) → **429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS**.
19. **Household assignment** — find existing owners sharing normalized lastName+address, compute a deterministic `householdId` (SHA-256, first 12 hex, upper-cased), and **⚠️ side-effect: persist every existing household member whose `householdId` changed** via `clinicService.saveOwner(member)` — writes to *other* rows, each in its own transaction.
20. **Duplicate/identity check** — build `identityKey = telephone|email|householdId`; if any existing owner matches → **409 CONFLICT**.
21. **Set derived fields on the new owner**: `customerCode` (`CITY3-LAST3-NNNN`), `membershipNumber` (`<customerCode>-M<YY>`), `namesakeCount` (count of existing same first+last name).
22. **Persist the new owner** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` → `@Transactional`, `ownerRepository.save` (persist since id is null; `pets` cascade ALL).
23. **Audit log side-effect** — one line to the dedicated `AUDIT` logger (`owner created: id=…`).
24. **Build response** — map to `OwnerDto`, set `bulkSignupWarning` flag (true if >80 owners registered today), set `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header → **201 CREATED**.

## Notes
- The **service layer is a thin pass-through** — all business logic/validation lives in the controller; `saveOwner` just delegates to the repository inside a transaction.
- The **entity carries its own Bean Validation** (`Owner`/`Person`: `@NotEmpty` on firstName, lastName, address, city, telephone; telephone `@Pattern("^(\+[0-9]{8,15}|[0-9]{10})$")`), enforced by Hibernate on flush — a second validation layer behind the DTO.
- **No JPA lifecycle callbacks / auditing** (`@PrePersist`, `@EntityListeners`, `@CreatedDate` etc.) exist — `registrationDate` is set manually, not by auditing.
- **No email is sent and no Spring event is published** anywhere in this path; the only outbound "notification" is the AUDIT log line.
- The controller itself is **not `@Transactional`**, so the household-member writes (step 19) and the new-owner save (step 22) commit as separate transactions.
